01.summary: Identify workshop hazards, prevent electrostatic damage, and handle tools and cleaning supplies safely.

questions.prompt: You are laying out a shared repair bench. Where should its power strip cable run?
choices: Across the main walkway
Along the wall, clear of foot traffic
Across the front edge of the work surface

questions.prompt: Your work area is carpeted and you need to unpack a motherboard. What is the best setup?
choices: Place the board on a fleece blanket
Unpack the board on the carpet
Move to a grounded ESD work surface before unbagging it

questions.prompt: The CPU heat spreader is still wet after cleaning. What should you do before proceeding?
choices: Let the cleaning alcohol evaporate completely
Apply thermal paste over the remaining liquid
Install the cooler and power on to dry it

02.summary: Explore computer architecture, CPU sockets, memory, storage, and power delivery.

questions.prompt: What stage of information processing begins when the computer receives a keystroke?
choices: Storage
Output
Input

questions.prompt: Before buying a replacement CPU, which reference best verifies it can run on a particular motherboard?
choices: The monitor's product manual
The motherboard's CPU support list and required BIOS versions
The case's maximum graphics card length

questions.prompt: A 2.5-inch SATA SSD is mounted inside a desktop. What connections does it ordinarily need?
choices: A SATA data cable and a SATA power cable
A SATA data cable only
An EPS CPU power cable and a USB data cable

03.summary: Prepare a chassis, install components, route power and data cables, and verify the build before starting it.

questions.prompt: You are preparing to mount the motherboard. Where should each standoff line up?
choices: Under any open spot on the motherboard
Under a hole where the board will be secured with a screw
Under a rear port to support the connector

questions.prompt: The marking on the CPU is a small triangle. What should you align it with during installation?
choices: The triangle or orientation mark on the socket
The closest memory slot latch
The CPU cooler fan header

questions.prompt: A cable crosses a case fan's blade path before the first boot. What should you do?
choices: Boot briefly to see whether the blades clear it
Disconnect the fan and leave the cable in place
Reroute and secure the cable away from the blades before powering on

04.summary: Navigate firmware settings, choose a boot mode and partition scheme, and deploy an operating system and drivers.

questions.prompt: A freshly installed SSD is absent in firmware setup. What should you check before starting an OS installation?
choices: Whether the drive is seated and the motherboard supports its interface
Whether the desktop wallpaper has loaded
Whether the installed OS has the latest browser

questions.prompt: You want to run a virtual machine, but its software reports that hardware virtualization is disabled. Which setting should you check?
choices: Storage boot order
CPU fan curve
Intel VT-x or AMD SVM in firmware setup

questions.prompt: You need to boot a USB installer once while keeping the internal drive first in the normal boot order. Which control fits?
choices: The RAM overclocking profile
The firmware's one-time boot menu
The permanent boot priority list

05.summary: Identify network devices and cabling, configure IPv4, and diagnose connectivity.

questions.prompt: On a small LAN, which device normally forwards traffic from the local network to another IP network?
choices: A patch panel
A router
An unmanaged Ethernet switch

questions.prompt: You want a standard straight-through patch cable using T568B. Which termination should you use?
choices: T568A at one end and T568B at the other
T568B at the first end and reversed pin order at the other
T568B at both ends

questions.prompt: A PC can reach other devices on its subnet by IP but needs a route to an external network. Which IPv4 setting identifies its usual next hop?
choices: Default gateway
DNS server
Subnet mask

06.summary: Practice preventive maintenance and isolate hardware, peripheral, and operating system faults.

questions.prompt: Before opening a dusty desktop for preventive maintenance, what is the appropriate first action?
choices: Run a CPU stress test while removing the panels
Switch the fans to maximum speed
Shut down and disconnect AC power

questions.prompt: After one repair restores normal operation, what information makes that repair reproducible?
choices: The symptoms, the change made, and how normal operation was verified
The time of day only
A list of parts you might replace someday

questions.prompt: After a graphics driver update, Windows reaches Safe Mode but fails during a normal boot. What should you test first?
choices: Replace both memory modules
Roll back the recent graphics driver in Safe Mode and retest
Repartition the system drive immediately
